review_subject: Claude-developed controllable-flux motor documentation, wiki, HTML, experiments, tests, reports, and git state

baseline.head_commit: 7b9887e feat(sim): 补齐EXP-006非线性磁链LUT实验

summary.overall_assessment: Claude mainline has advanced to reproducible numeric proxy coverage for EXP-001 through EXP-010, but documentation entry points, wiki, HTML, manifests, and some metadata lag behind the current experiment and coverage facts.
summary.highest_risk: State drift between models/scheme_simulation_coverage.json and human-facing documentation can cause duplicated work or incorrect engineering interpretation.
summary.engineering_boundary: passed_numeric_simulation means reproducible numeric/proxy simulation only; all current results remain engineering_validated=false unless explicitly replaced by FEA, HIL, bench, thermal, EMC, safety, and hardware evidence.

findings.title: Claude docs entry points lag behind current EXP-001 through EXP-010 coverage
findings.recommended_action: Update README and handoff to state that EXP-001 through EXP-010 have reproducible numeric/proxy coverage while preserving engineering_validated=false limitations.

findings.title: Claude evidence manifest does not index latest experiment artifacts
findings.recommended_action: Add EXP-005 through EXP-010 plus EXP-006 schema/sample/summary/CSV to the manifest.

findings.title: Wiki and HTML experiment matrices use stale numbering and stale status
findings.recommended_action: Rewrite the active wiki and HTML experiment matrix around actual EXP-001 through EXP-010 directories, then refresh claude-docs snapshots and manifest references.

findings.title: codex-docs still treats nonlinear_flux_lut as the only needs_next_numeric_model item
findings.recommended_action: Either mark codex-docs as historical branch documentation or update it to acknowledge the current EXP-006 synthetic LUT numeric proof.

findings.title: Coverage metadata references a non-existent pytest file
findings.recommended_action: Replace tests/test_control_search.py with an existing mainline test or add the missing test, then strengthen coverage tests to assert every pytest_tests path exists.
resolution: Replaced the missing tests/test_control_search.py coverage reference with tests/test_exp_001_runner.py.
Strengthened tests/test_scheme_simulation_coverage.py to assert every pytest_tests path exists.

findings.title: Engineering catalog deliverables mix existing artifacts and future placeholders
findings.recommended_action: Split deliverables into existing_artifacts and planned_deliverables, and test that existing artifacts exist.

findings.title: Toolchain documentation has uncommitted PyFluent and Fluent clarification changes
findings.recommended_action: Review and commit the toolchain clarification separately from experiment-status synchronization.

findings.title: .claude local agent directory is untracked and not ignored
findings.recommended_action: Decide whether to ignore .claude/ or extract only intentional long-lived workflow files into a tracked project directory.

next_review_steps: Fix P0 documentation and coverage drift before adding new experiments.
Regenerate or manually align wiki, HTML, snapshots, and evidence manifest after active source updates.
Add automated consistency checks so stale pytest paths, stale artifact paths, and missing engineering_validated fields fail early.
Continue appending future Codex review reports under codex-review/docs with evidence-backed findings.
